signature.name: VTask.cons
signature.type: {G : Type u_1} -> [Group G] -> {A B : Subgroup G} -> {d : HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair G A B} -> (g : G) -> (u : ℤˣ) -> (w : HNNExtension.NormalWord d) -> (h1 : w.head ∈ d.set u) -> (h2 : ∀ u' ∈ Option.map Prod.fst w.toList.head?, w.head ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup A B u → u = u') -> HNNExtension.NormalWord d

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: All arguments are constrained by explicit types and propositions; the function is total on its stated domain and no junk-value or edge conventions apply.

facts.statement: ∀ {G : Type*} [Group G] {A B : Subgroup G} {d : HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair G A B} (g : G) (u : ℤˣ) (w : HNNExtension.NormalWord d) (h1 : w.head ∈ d.set u) (h2 : ∀ u' ∈ Option.map Prod.fst w.toList.head?, w.head ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup A B u → u = u'), (1 : G) • VTask.cons g u w h1 h2 = VTask.cons g u w h1 h2

facts.statement: ∀ {G : Type*} [Group G] {A B : Subgroup G} {d : HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair G A B} (g₁ g₂ : G) (u : ℤˣ) (w : HNNExtension.NormalWord d) (h1 : w.head ∈ d.set u) (h2 : ∀ u' ∈ Option.map Prod.fst w.toList.head?, w.head ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup A B u → u = u'), VTask.cons g₁ u w h1 h2 ≠ HNNExtension.NormalWord.ofGroup g₂

facts.statement: ∀ {G : Type*} [Group G] {A B : Subgroup G} {d : HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair G A B} (g₁ g₂ g₃ : G) (u : ℤˣ) (w : HNNExtension.NormalWord d) (h1 : w.head ∈ d.set u) (h2 : ∀ u' ∈ Option.map Prod.fst w.toList.head?, w.head ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup A B u → u = u'), g₁ • (g₂ • VTask.cons g₃ u w h1 h2) = VTask.cons (g₁ * g₂ * g₃) u w h1 h2

facts.statement: ∀ {G : Type*} [Group G] {A B : Subgroup G} {d : HNNExtension.NormalWord.TransversalPair G A B} (g₁ g₂ : G) (w₁ w₂ : HNNExtension.NormalWord d) (h1a : w₁.head ∈ d.set 1) (h2a : ∀ u' ∈ Option.map Prod.fst w₁.toList.head?, w₁.head ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup A B 1 → (1 : ℤˣ) = u') (h1b : w₂.head ∈ d.set (-1)) (h2b : ∀ u' ∈ Option.map Prod.fst w₂.toList.head?, w₂.head ∈ HNNExtension.toSubgroup A B (-1) → (-1 : ℤˣ) = u'), VTask.cons g₁ 1 w₁ h1a h2a ≠ VTask.cons g₂ (-1) w₂ h1b h2b
